# Sightings — pre-card observations
- 2026-10-28 · s6-campaign-one/20261028T113149_facade/mined/it-1/flow-1.md#L385-L401 · An exact evaluator-invocation dry run caught both a missing root entrypoint and a post-write diagnostic crash, showing that the working directory, invoked path, and clean process exit—not merely a predictions file—formed the submission contract.
- 2026-10-28 · s6-campaign-one/20261028T113149_facade/mined/it-1/flow-1.md#L54-L178 · Measuring several cheap model routes during ideation supplied numeric performance and timing gates for the single build, which then met every gate early, although the one-campaign record does not isolate measurement as the cause of that speed.
- 2026-10-28 · s6-campaign-one/20261028T113149_facade/mined/artifacts.md#L35-L81 · The engine eagerly built and refreshed repository memory and a shared-cache artifact that no session or later round consumed in a one-round campaign, leaving a pre-judging refresh on the critical path with placeholder experiment metadata.
- 2026-10-28 · s6-campaign-one/20261028T113149_facade/mined/operations.md#L147-L153 · The campaign brief, launch configuration, status accounting, and judge used conflicting time budgets, although the run finished early enough that the disagreement did not affect execution or assessment.
- 2026-10-28 · s6-campaign-one/20261028T113149_facade/mined/operations.md#L158-L168 · A harvested campaign bundle retained an unredacted plaintext credential that appeared in workspace inventories even though no recorded session printed its value.
- 2026-10-28 · s6-campaign-one/20261028T113149_facade/mined/index.md#L102-L112 · The harvested record was incomplete and internally inconsistent across planning history, prompts, manifest state, copied text, and unrelated fixture metrics, without changing the campaign's decisions.
- 2026-10-28 · s6-campaign-one/20261028T113149_facade/mined/it-1/flow-1.md#L56-L69 · A weaker flexible ranker blended into a stronger structured model slightly reduced shared-fold AUC, without evidence that the models' errors complemented each other.
- 2026-10-28 · s6-campaign-one/20261028T113149_facade/mined/it-1/flow-1.md#L79-L112 · In one synthetic run, replacing missing basis terms with fold-local unconditional expectations changed pooled AUC by less than the reseed variation, while no conditional imputer was measured.
- 2026-10-28 · s6-campaign-one/20261028T113149_facade/mined/it-1/flow-1.md#L208-L218 · An implementor independently added a displacement margin when a tiny cross-validation edge sat inside reseed variation, avoiding a raw-argmax switch to extra noise features, but no agent made that mistake and its downstream cost was not measured.
- 2026-10-28 · s6-campaign-one/20261028T113149_facade/mined/it-1/flow-1.md#L260-L273 · The implemented challenger silently changed its feature set and regularization relative to the registered comparison, so its tiny ordering change did not replay the registered candidates, while no exact replay isolated the drift's effect.
